Isolated middle distance scenery on plain pale gray background: at left a low abandoned blue gray railway carriage with broken frost-covered windows, at right a receding simple railway waiting shelter, two slender signal posts offset from center. Objects occupy x=0..30 percent and x=77..100 percent, y=30..67 percent. Central 45 percent remains completely empty. Bottom of all structures aligns at 67 percent canvas height. Small amber window reflections, readable angular hand painted silhouettes.

Independent 2D game environment layer. Snowbound abandoned railway station, side-on horizontal camera, no vanishing-point tilt. Entire canvas 1344 by 768. Matte painterly anime background with broad deliberate brush shapes, selective broken edges, slate blue and muted teal with restrained amber light. No characters, no lettering, no interface. Consistent station floor registration at y=522 (68 percent height).
